feature_request: Add password validation to the login system. Require at least 8 characters, one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character. Also add tests for valid and invalid passwords.
acceptance_criteria: The login system must reject passwords with a length of less than 8 characters.
The login system must reject passwords that do not contain at least one uppercase letter.
The login system must reject passwords that do not contain at least one number.
The login system must reject passwords that do not contain at least one special character.
New tests must verify that valid passwords meeting all criteria are accepted and specific invalid variations are rejected.
